caption: The drawing depicts a single, symmetrical metallic object with an elongated, pointed-arch shape resembling a shield or the blade of a garden spade. The structure is composed of ornate, dark brown, wrought-iron-like material, featuring a combination of flowing, curved lines and geometric shapes. The upper portion has an enclosed teardrop ornament at the peak with three vertical bars extending downwards from it, flanked by S-shaped scrolls on each side. Below the scrolls, two larger loops intersect and merge at the bottom, forming a heart-like loop with a small rounded feature at the tip. The object is centered on an off-white or light beige background, and there are no additional objects in the composition. A small signature "SYD F. ROBERTS" is written beneath the depicted object toward the bottom right.
title: Trivet
